problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: size 37 cubic meters
* Shipment Beta: size 65 cubic meters
* Shipment Gamma: size 68 cubic meters
* Shipment Delta: size 39 cubic meters
* Shipment Epsilon: size 58 cubic meters
* Shipment Zeta: size 55 cubic meters
* Shipment Eta: size 41 cubic meters
* Shipment Theta: size 56 cubic meters
* Shipment Iota: size 57 cubic meters
* Shipment Kappa: size 41 cubic meters
* Shipment Lambda: size 45 cubic meters
* Shipment Mu: size 59 cubic meters
* Shipment Nu: size 51 cubic meters
* Shipment Xi: size 63 cubic meters
* Shipment Omicron: size 39 cubic meters

Each cargo plane can carry up to 100 cubic meters of freight. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Each shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume on any plane cannot exceed its capacity.
